description.text: Objectives: Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine as well as the fundamental skills on medical treatment and disease-prevention. These medical professionals should undertake medical treatments, disease-prevention, teaching and research in health and medical communities, colleges and research institutions. Core Disciplines: Basic Medicine & Clinical Medicine Major Courses: Histoembryology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, Preventive Medicine, Medical Immunology, Physical Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Gynemetrics, Paediatrics, Laboratory Diagnosis, Medical Iconography, Surgery Pandect, Epidemiology, Functional Experiment, Pathophysiology, Systematic Anatomy, Medical Microbiology Degree Awarded: Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation: Graduates are supposed to undertake research, teaching, management and clinical treatment in medical organizations, research institutions and medical schools at all levels.

duration.text: The Applied Psychology at Fujian Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Certification of no criminal record Other materials Student’s Information Form

requirements.text: 1) Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport and in good health; 2) Senior high school graduates or with educational background at above level, or equivalent to that of a Chinese senior high school graduate or above, with results of B or above (more than 70 for a hundred-mark system); and 3) Applicant's level of proficiency in Chinese shall reach elementary C (Level 3) or above in HSK. High school graduates with Chinese as the main teaching language in all courses are free from HSK certificates.
